items.title: How much does the compounding bug actually cost?
items.description: Reproduces the buggy applyDiscount behavior from L3: applying the same discount rate twice compounds instead of being rejected. Defaults (10% rate, $100 order) reproduce the unit's exact $81 reading. Drag either slider to see how the erroneous extra discount grows.
items.compute: const rate = params.discountRate / 100; const correct = Math.round(params.orderTotal * (1 - rate) * 100) / 100; const buggy = Math.round(params.orderTotal * (1 - rate) * (1 - rate) * 100) / 100; return { erroneousDiscount: Math.round((correct - buggy) * 100) / 100 };

outputs.label: Extra amount lost to the bug
